title: Pearl Migration
description: A six-bar melody begins low in the piano, rises two octaves, briefly runs at twice its original pace, and finally appears three octaves above its first home. Each migration changes the accompanying harmony. Soft chords draw the high voice back towards the centre, closing in E major with a lingering ninth.
difficulty: Advanced melodic projection across registers and rhythmic diminution
technical_note: The entire first six-bar bass phrase returns in RH bars 7–12 two octaves higher, is compressed by half in bars 13–15, and returns three octaves above its original register at 19–24. Keep the running version connected to the same phrase shape, without forcing the high register.

performance.note: Bring the initial bass tune forward. Each higher version recalls its unhurried phrasing, including the half-duration version. Let the last chords ease the ear back into the middle register.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
